decisions.quote: This paper describes the scale and composition of emergency demand for police services in Detroit, United States. The contribution is made in replication and extension of analyses reported elsewhere in the United States.
decisions.reason: No prior adjudication or prior state file exists for this work. The supplied primary source text (6f44ccf5f34d3f8f.txt) contains only the title and abstract, without full text or a reference list. The abstract states that the contribution is made 'in replication and extension of analyses reported elsewhere in the United States' but names no specific authors, years, or titles. Consequently, the available primary evidence cannot determine whether the unnamed target refers solely to the two shipped rows (input_row_index 2089, Lum, Koper, & Wu, 2021; and input_row_index 2090, Ratcliffe, 2021) or also retests an additional unshipped study.
